Thanks for the detail. Partnerships, commissions and anything to do with marketing or pricing are decided by Georges here, so I've passed your proposal and the links straight to him. He'll reply in this thread if it's something we want to take further.

I can't move the conversation to WhatsApp or another channel, and I'm not able to agree to a commission arrangement myself. Replying here is the right place, and everything you send reaches him.

Best regards,
